events.title: DUMMY HOUSE on Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone!DUMMY HOUSE will be part of Steam Next Fest, running from October 19 to October 26!If you haven't tried the demo yet, this is a great time to check it out. And if you've already played it, thank you for giving our game a chance!We're a small team of just two people working hard on the full release, and we're happy to be part of the event.And one more thing: the full game launches on October 30, just four days after Steam Next Fest ends!See you at the Next Fest!— The Crossover Studio

events.title: 1.000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Knowing that there are so many people around the world having fun and being interested in DUMMY HOUSE makes all our work worth it.I’m not good with words, expressing feelings, and much less putting myself in the spotlight.
